selection_rule: Must support both Turkish and English out of the box, or be a documented Turkish-matched Whisper fine-tune used only on the TR subset. English-only 2026 leaderboard models are recorded as rejected, not evaluated as multilingual systems. Pilot IDs stay so the original tables remain comparable. Refresh IDs are the newest compatible checkpoints as of this snapshot.

asr_selected.notes: Original paper baseline. Lowest WER in the pilot.
Original paper multilingual reference. Still the latest official OpenAI Whisper accuracy checkpoint.
Pruned Large-v3 decoder (32->4 layers). Same language set, much faster. Still the latest official OpenAI Whisper speed checkpoint.
Transformers-native Qwen3-ASR. Turkish is an official support language. Prefer this ID over Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B. Latest Qwen ASR as of 2026-09-04.
Same language set as 1.7B, smaller/faster sibling.

June 2026 NVIDIA multilingual streaming ASR. Turkish (tr-TR) and English (en-US) are official transcription-ready locales. This is the NVIDIA model that passes the TR+EN rule Parakeet/Canary failed. Requires transformers>=5.13. Long-form audio is decoded in non-overlapping 60 s windows.
Common Voice 17 Turkish fine-tune of Whisper Turbo. Run only on TR-1..TR-3. Addresses limitation (a).

asr_pilot.notes: Same checkpoint as asr_selected. Listed here so --all-pilot reproduces the original four-system set.
Hub ID cited in the paper. This is a pretrained encoder; if the pipeline has no CTC head the run will fail and the exact fine-tune used in the pilot must be recorded here.

The paper said 'SpeechBrain with default greedy/beam settings' but did not pin a Hub ID. This is a documented English LibriSpeech default. Confirm or replace before treating SpeechBrain rows as a reproduction of the pilot.

llm_selected.notes: Kept so the completed pilot semantic table remains comparable.
Default ablation LLM. Kept so the pilot semantic table remains comparable.

Free ungated Apache-2.0 Qwen3.5 dense model. Replaces paid GPT-5.6 Sol as the 2026 capacity counterpart to GPT-4.1, and supersedes Qwen3-8B. Native multimodal architecture; the kit runs it text-only with thinking disabled. Qwen3.8-27B is newer but too large for the kit laptop GPU.

Free ungated Apache-2.0 Qwen3.5 small model. Default for new ablation runs (no API key). Replaces Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and the paid GPT-5.6 Luna slot. Fits the RTX 5060 Laptop in bf16. Thinking disabled for JSON term extraction.

rejected.reason: 25 European languages only. Turkish is not in the official list (bg,hr,cs,da,nl,en,et,fi,fr,de,el,hu,it,lv,lt,mt,pl,pt,ro,sk,sl,es,sv,ru,uk). Nemotron 3.5 ASR is the NVIDIA model that does list Turkish.
Same 25-language European set as Parakeet v3. No Turkish.
English only. Would repeat the unfair Wav2Vec2/SpeechBrain comparison.
31-language multilingual Fun-ASR. Official list has no Turkish.
Has Turkish, but CC-BY-NC-4.0 and a 2024 speech-translation stack, not a 2026 ASR specialist.
Has Turkish, but gated (gated=auto) and CC-BY-NC-4.0. Optional later if a HF token is available.
Kept only as the original English-oriented pilot checkpoint, not as a 2026 refresh candidate.
Superseded on 2026-09-04 by Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B. Still public; not a language-coverage reject.
Superseded on 2026-09-04 by Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B. Still public; not a language-coverage reject.
Newest Qwen open dense model (2026-08-14) but 27B is not practical on the kit RTX 5060 Laptop. Recorded so the size cut is explicit.
Paid OpenAI API. This project cannot use paid hosted models for new runs. Free replacement: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B.
Paid OpenAI API. Same no-paid-model rule. Free replacement for new ablation: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B.
Paid OpenAI API (released 2026-09-03). Excluded under the no-paid-model rule.
